purpose: One record per submitted outbound link. The intended fields and the observed fields are stored separately and are never merged, reconciled or used to fill each other in.
rule: An 'intended' value may only be written after the destination has been confirmed inside the enrolled Associates workflow. Until that happens the field stays empty. Published product links carry exactly one query parameter, tag=shopnow047c-20, on the observed listing URL; that is a submitted tracking ID, not a validated Special Link, and no click has been confirmed in a report.
